metadata.overview: Sensitive points (Sphutas) are mathematically derived degrees that act as trigger points for specific life themes. Unlike planets, they have no independent motion — they are activated only when planets transit over them or aspect them.

bhrigu_bindu.definition: The midpoint between Rahu and natal Moon. The most sensitive timing degree in a birth chart.
bhrigu_bindu.formula: Midpoint of Rahu longitude and Moon longitude (shorter arc)
bhrigu_bindu.activation_rule: Any planet transiting within 1° of Bhrigu Bindu = major life event in that planet's significations
bhrigu_bindu.natal_conjunction_rule: Any natal planet conjunct Bhrigu Bindu (within 3°) = that planet's themes are karmically fated and operate through sudden, destined events
bhrigu_bindu.why_it_works: Rahu represents karmic obsession and desire; Moon represents the mind and emotional self. Their midpoint is the exact degree where desire and mind intersect — the karmic meeting point. Any activation here triggers the subconscious into manifestation.

transit_activators.jupiter: Most auspicious activation — dharma, wisdom, children, expansion events
transit_activators.saturn: Karmic reckoning activation — discipline, losses, restructuring events
transit_activators.rahu: Obsessive, foreign, unconventional activation — sudden changes
transit_activators.ketu: Spiritual, past-karma activation — endings, detachment, liberation
transit_activators.mars: Action, property, conflict activation — sudden assertive events
transit_activators.venus: Relationship, wealth, beauty activation — romantic or financial events
transit_activators.sun: Authority, father, career activation — recognition or confrontation
transit_activators.moon: Monthly activation — emotional events, mother, public matters

house_significance_by_sign.taurus: Events around wealth, speech, food, family
house_significance_by_sign.gemini: Events around communication, siblings, short travel, business
house_significance_by_sign.cancer: Events around home, mother, property, emotional foundation
house_significance_by_sign.leo: Events around children, creativity, speculation, romance
house_significance_by_sign.virgo: Events around health, enemies, service, debts
house_significance_by_sign.scorpio: Events around transformation, occult, inheritance, death-rebirth
house_significance_by_sign.sagittarius: Events around dharma, father, foreign travel, higher learning
house_significance_by_sign.capricorn: Events around career, authority, public standing, government
house_significance_by_sign.aquarius: Events around gains, elder siblings, networks, aspirations
house_significance_by_sign.pisces: Events around losses, foreign lands, spirituality, liberation

advanced_rules: When Jupiter transits Bhrigu Bindu = the single most auspicious timing point in any year — major positive events
When Saturn transits BB = major karmic event — can be difficult or culminating depending on Saturn's strength
When the current dasha lord's natal position is conjunct BB = peak manifestation of that dasha's themes
BB in a kendra (1,4,7,10) from lagna = events are very visible and public
BB in a trikona (1,5,9) = dharmic, auspicious events when activated
BB in a dusthana (6,8,12) = private, hidden events; challenges before rewards

indu_lagna.definition: The wealth sensitive point calculated from Jupiter and Moon house lords' Bindu values. Shows when and through what channel wealth flows.
indu_lagna.formula: Jupiter's house lord Bindu + Moon's house lord Bindu, counted from lagna

interpretation_by_sign.aries: Wealth through courage, pioneering ventures, sports, military, leadership
interpretation_by_sign.taurus: Wealth through land, food, beauty, arts, accumulated assets, banking
interpretation_by_sign.gemini: Wealth through communication, business, technology, writing, trading
interpretation_by_sign.cancer: Wealth through property, real estate, nourishment, public service, mother
interpretation_by_sign.leo: Wealth through authority, government, creative arts, speculation
interpretation_by_sign.virgo: Wealth through service, analysis, health, editing, systematic work
interpretation_by_sign.libra: Wealth through partnerships, beauty, luxury, design, legal work
interpretation_by_sign.scorpio: Wealth through research, transformation, occult, inheritance, deep investigation
interpretation_by_sign.sagittarius: Wealth through dharma, teaching, foreign connections, publishing, philosophy
interpretation_by_sign.capricorn: Wealth through discipline, hard work, government, long-term ventures
interpretation_by_sign.aquarius: Wealth through technology, innovation, networks, humanitarian work
interpretation_by_sign.pisces: Wealth through spirituality, foreign lands, research, creativity, hidden sources

indu_lagna_lord_rules.strong_lord: When Indu Lagna lord is strong (own sign, exalted, well-placed) = wealth flows abundantly through that channel
indu_lagna_lord_rules.weak_lord: When Indu Lagna lord is weak (debilitated, combust, in dusthana) = wealth channel is obstructed
indu_lagna_lord_rules.dasha_activation: When the Indu Lagna lord runs as dasha lord = peak wealth period
indu_lagna_lord_rules.transit_activation: Jupiter transiting Indu Lagna = major wealth inflow that year
indu_lagna_lord_rules.saturn_transit: Saturn transiting Indu Lagna = wealth through discipline/effort or wealth restriction

timing_rules: Jupiter transiting Indu Lagna sign = best year for wealth accumulation in that 12-year cycle
Dasha of Indu Lagna lord = sustained wealth period
Antardasha of Indu Lagna lord within any Mahadasha = wealth sub-period
When multiple transits activate Indu Lagna simultaneously = windfall possible

sree_lagna.definition: The prosperity sensitive point calculated from Moon + Venus. The degree of abundance and material fulfillment.
sree_lagna.why_it_works: Moon represents desire and nourishment; Venus represents beauty and material comfort. Their combined longitude creates the degree of maximum material fulfillment — where both emotional satisfaction and material comfort converge.

interpretation_by_sign.aries: Prosperity through action, initiation, physical work, sports
interpretation_by_sign.taurus: Prosperity through beauty, food, luxury, land, arts — most natural Sree Lagna placement
interpretation_by_sign.gemini: Prosperity through intellect, commerce, communication networks
interpretation_by_sign.cancer: Prosperity through nourishment, real estate, public service, emotional resonance
interpretation_by_sign.leo: Prosperity through creativity, performance, authority, speculation
interpretation_by_sign.virgo: Prosperity through service, precision work, health, analysis
interpretation_by_sign.libra: Prosperity through partnerships, beauty, balanced exchange, contracts
interpretation_by_sign.scorpio: Prosperity through transformation, research, inheritance, depth of knowledge
interpretation_by_sign.sagittarius: Prosperity through wisdom, teaching, foreign connections, expansion
interpretation_by_sign.capricorn: Prosperity through structured work, government, long-term discipline
interpretation_by_sign.aquarius: Prosperity through innovation, technology, groups, humanitarian causes
interpretation_by_sign.pisces: Prosperity through spirituality, creativity, foreign income, hidden channels

sree_lagna.relationship_to_indu_lagna: Indu Lagna shows the CHANNEL of wealth (how it comes). Sree Lagna shows the DEGREE of prosperity (how much abundance is possible). When both are activated simultaneously = peak prosperity period.

house_from_lagna_rules.house_1: Prosperity tied to personal identity and self-expression
house_from_lagna_rules.house_2: Natural placement — direct wealth accumulation, family resources
house_from_lagna_rules.house_3: Prosperity through effort, communication, skills, siblings
house_from_lagna_rules.house_4: Prosperity through property, mother, emotional intelligence
house_from_lagna_rules.house_5: Prosperity through speculation, creativity, children, intelligence
house_from_lagna_rules.house_6: Prosperity requires overcoming obstacles, service, health work
house_from_lagna_rules.house_9: Prosperity through dharma, teaching, father, foreign connections
house_from_lagna_rules.house_10: Career-linked prosperity — public recognition brings abundance
house_from_lagna_rules.house_11: Best placement — gains, networks, aspirations all support prosperity
house_from_lagna_rules.house_12: Spiritual prosperity or prosperity in foreign lands

activation_rules: Benefic planet transiting Sree Lagna = prosperity activation that month
Jupiter transiting Sree Lagna = peak prosperity year in 12-year cycle
Dasha of Sree Lagna lord = sustained prosperity period
When Sree Lagna lord is the same as Indu Lagna lord = double wealth concentration — very auspicious

combined_analysis.all_three_active: When Bhrigu Bindu, Indu Lagna, and Sree Lagna are all activated simultaneously by Jupiter transit = the single most powerful financial-karmic year in a 12-year cycle
combined_analysis.bb_in_indu_lagna_sign: When Bhrigu Bindu falls in the same sign as Indu Lagna = karmic destined wealth — wealth events come through fated encounters
combined_analysis.sree_in_bb_sign: When Sree Lagna falls in the same sign as Bhrigu Bindu = prosperity and fate are linked — abundance comes through unexpected channels
combined_analysis.natal_planets_on_sphutas: Any natal planet within 3° of any sphuta = that planet operates through that sphuta's energy — fated expression of that planet's themes
